transcript.text: Alright everyone, before we make any final decisions about the boat, I want to go around and hear from each of you. We've got the 16-foot wooden rowboat from Uncle's inheritance sitting on sawhorses beside my house right now, and we need to figure out storage before the rainy season hits. We've talked about a covered garage, an outdoor rack, or donating it. There's also that informal river-cleanup morning coming up sometime this summer, which might factor into things. So — does anyone have anything I should know before I start weighing our options?
